summary: Retested inventory/order fixes with real Supabase + browser flows: backend regression passed fully, block-date submit/sync works across tabs, successful future guest checkout and schedule visibility verified, and admin cancellation lock behavior verified.

ui_bugs.issue: `menu-schedule-date` input was intermittently unavailable immediately after selecting 'Schedule for Later' in repeated automation runs; manual/debug run shows it rendering correctly.

integration_issues.flow: Guest checkout automation post-click state check
integration_issues.issue: `place-order-submit` locator became detached during immediate in-flight disabled check while checkout still succeeded and navigated to success state.

issues: No horizontal overflow detected at tested 320/768/1024/1440 widths.

action_items: Review/deflake schedule-picker hydration timing so `menu-schedule-date` appears deterministically right after toggling later mode in all runs.
Optional UX hardening: keep a stable test hook/state marker during checkout submit transition to avoid detached-button race in automation.
Clean leftover iteration1 QA fixture: menu_items.id `qa-inventory-del-c6725e94`.
Consider replacing empty image src values with null/fallback to remove Next/Image console errors seen on menu pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Console repeatedly reports Next/Image issues (`empty src` / `missing src`) on menu cards; sanitize image values before rendering image components.
Address step inputs lack `data-testid`, reducing UI test maintainability for checkout regressions.
Build is currently mutating tsconfig include paths for custom DIST_DIR builds; keep this intentional in CI to avoid noisy diffs.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (critical flows mostly verified; schedule-picker automation flake remains)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated `qa-inventory-iter2-*` items in tests and auto-cleaned them. Guest/admin QA orders were created during browser/API verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Block date submit no-op was not reproducible: request logs captured POST /rpc/set_blocked_date 200 and cross-tab realtime block/unblock succeeded without reload. Future guest checkout succeeded (confirmed by success screen, tracked schedule, and admin order schedule for LB-D0596B1BD90B4F759C315D86FA4F9955). Admin cancel was executed from UI and cancelled order became non-reopenable in UI (status selector disabled). Backend cancellation/permission/now-order tests are in test_inventory_permissions_and_cancellation.py and all pass.
rca of the issue: RCA (remaining test friction): automation races during fast UI transitions, not backend failures. Specifically, immediately asserting `place-order-submit` disabled can fail because the success view unmounts the button quickly after successful submit; likewise, schedule-date selector intermittently appears late after mode toggle during hydration/realtime churn. Mitigation: await explicit rendered markers (e.g., schedule input visibility state token) and assert success element before checking transient button states.
